shellCommands.command: ls -la; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; node --version; npm --version; python3 --version
cat package.json .gitignore; ls node_modules; ls -R __agent_eval__ | head
printf 'data/\n' >> .gitignore; cat .gitignore; npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -15

export BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3999; rm -rf /tmp/smoke
node server.js & P=$!; sleep 0.5
L=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -d 'title=Middlemarch&author=George Eliot&notes=Slow start' localhost:3999/books); echo "link: $L"
kill $P; wait $P 2>/dev/null
node server.js & P=$!; sleep 0.5
curl -s "$L" | grep -E '<h2>|by |notes'; cat $BOOKS_FILE; kill $P
